text: At its meeting on April 16, 2026, the Toronto Transit Commission considered item TTC14.13 and made a recommendation to City Council. Summary from the Toronto Transit Commission The TTC has completed a review and update of its Records Retention Schedule to ensure continued alignment with legislative requirements, operational needs, and records management best practices.
